title: 2023 AMC 10B Problem 4
statement: Jackson’s paintbrush makes a narrow strip with a width of \(6.5\) millimeters. Jackson has enough paint to make a strip \(25\) meters long. How many square centimeters of paper could Jackson cover with paint?

solutions.text: Put everything in centimeters first. The strip is \(6.5\) mm \(= 0.65\) cm wide and \(25\) m \(= 2500\) cm long. Its area is \(0.65 \times 2500 = 1625\) square centimeters. Therefore, the answer is C.
hints: Convert everything to centimeters: \(6.5\) mm \(= 0.65\) cm and \(25\) m \(= 2500\) cm
Area is width \(\times\) length once both are in the same units
